description: Prices are rising for everybody in the country. We should be forward-thinking in ways to combat inflation and other increases in the cost of living. Whether it's housing, utility rates, or how much we're paying for groceries and gas, our officials have failed to stand up for working families and seniors who are feeling the squeeze right now. It's time for leadership that prioritizes the wellbeing of everyday Ohioans over political grandstanding and partisanship.

title: Cost-of-Living - Louis Murphy for Ohio's 99th
